description:
List detected anomalies (significant metric changes) across an app's vitals.

Set `action` to one of:
• list: List anomalies detected for the app, paginated. — requires: appId

appId.description: Reporting app id, e.g. the package name. Find it with play_reporting_apps.search.

filter.description: AIP-160 filter expression to narrow results.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

pageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response's nextPageToken.

name: play_vitals_anomalies
title: Vitals anomalies
